name: Flying Tulip USD
oneLiner: ftUSD is Flying Tulip's stablecoin minted 1:1 against USDC or USDT, with deposits routed to Aave and native assets borrowed against them to fund staking carry.
collateral: USDC and USDT supplied to Aave as long-side collateral; native assets borrowed against the stablecoin deposits and staked to generate carry, with yield routed to sftUSD stakers while unstaked ftUSD proceeds feed the protocol treasury
pegMechanism: Mint and redeem 1:1 against USDC or USDT through on-chain MintAndRedeem contract; deposits are supplied to Aave for carry while native assets borrowed against the stablecoin collateral are staked to generate additional yield; circuit-breaker contracts enforce position caps and rebalancing bands
